events.title: Update 0.2.0 - The Next Fest Demo is Here!
events.summary: Hello, everyone!Thanks again to everyone who played the Beta and sent us feedback. We read all of it, and a lot of it went straight into this update. The Next Fest demo picks up where the Beta left off, with more characters, more stuff, smarter enemies, and a lot of fixes.It's still only Act 1 of the 5 in the full game, and it still skips some story like the prologue intro, but there's still some things to dig into this time.Heads up: Beta saves won't carry over to the demo.
